{{Top|leg}}
A '''Standard Clear Frequency''',<ref name="RPG2">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> or '''SCF''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a communications frequency which was used for public communications. Uses for Standard Clear Frequencies included [[Starship/Legends|starships]] contacting [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] about landing instructions, governments broadcasting information to a specific area,<ref name="RPG2" /> civil defense warnings, providing information about local laws, and the locations of nearby facilities, including ones dedicated to medical, educational, and governmental purposes. [[Comlink/Legends|Comlinks]] monitored Standard Clear Frequencies.<ref name="EGWT" />
